messages:
alex: Heads up — opened a quick PR (compact-modules) to compress network modules and centralize provider pins. CI plan is failing on provider duplicates, can someone sanity-check?
morgan: on it. link?
alex: infra-bot posted link: https://ci.redwood/in/pr/4921/plan
infra-bot: Plan failed with: Error: Duplicate provider configuration for registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/google
alex: here's the plan output:
```bash
Error: Duplicate provider configuration
  on modules/network/main.tf line 2, in provider "google":
  2: provider "google" { }
```
carla: we've seen this when modules declare providers with version constraints and root has pinned provider too. Are you using providers = { } in module blocks?
alex: yeah, I hoisted providers but left some modules with explicit provider blocks. PR diff: removed provider blocks from modules/* except modules/legacy-db
morgan: quick linted check: run `terraform providers` in each module dir. Also check .terraform.lock.hcl differences.
sam: also saw secret mapping noise — k8s secret path for payments service got moved from k8s/ci/payments to k8s/shared/payments in the refactor. Deploys failing in staging.
alex: ugh. that's my bad. I updated module var names but not the secretmap in argocd overlay.
carla: propose to add a compatibility shim: in modules/iam add var secret_aliases = { "payments" = "k8s/ci/payments" } and default to new path if not present. Quick patch and re-run plan?
morgan: sounds good. For provider pinning, let's pin at root with required_providers { google = { version = "~> 4.0" } } and remove duplicate blocks. Then run `terraform init -reconfigure`.
alex: I'll push two commits: provider hoist + secret alias shim. pinging @sam for argocd overlay patch.
sam: will update overlays after you push, can do a quick canary in staging once plan passes.
infra-bot: CI Plan succeeded for PR #4921 — 2 resources to change (smoke).
carla: canary in staging ok? any latency regressions?
alex: did a deploy to staging, smoke passed, no secrets errors. :thumbsup: 
morgan: cool. two follow-ups: update agents.md in repo about module ownership, and add a lockfile regen step in PR template.
alex: noted. thanks everyone! merging after 30m hold and final lgtm.
sam: lgtm from ops, will monitor the canary.
infra-bot: Deploy started: staging compact-modules v6
alex: cheers — if anything flares, I'll revert.
